content.statement: The current returns policy v2 sets a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claimed 30-day window is correct.
content.plan: Extracted numeric windows from policy_docs and base_retrieval, compared current v2 (30 days) with stale v1/judge reference (14 days), computed delta and checked order age 10 days against both windows; no two-sample t-test was possible because no n/mean/sd fields were provided, so deterministic policy arithmetic was used.

evidence.two_sample_t_test: not applicable: no n, mean_*, or sd_* fields
